$comment: Ghost-command backlog allowlist — consumed by scripts/ghost-commands.cjs.
A "ghost" is a Tauri command registered in generate_handler![] that no
frontend code ever calls. Entries here are KNOWN, pre-existing ghosts: the
gate reports them loudly but does not block on them, so that NEW ghosts fail
the build from day one while this backlog is worked down.
Seeded 2026-08-14, when the detector was fixed. Until then it had counted a
command's CommandMap type key as proof the command was called, which another
blocking gate (scripts/validate-commands.cjs) guarantees always exists — so it
reported 0 ghosts and "IPC health 100%" while 30% of the IPC surface was dead.
TO CLEAR AN ENTRY: either wire the command up in the frontend, or delete it
from Rust + generate_handler![] + the CommandMap in src/lib/commands.ts. Then
DELETE its object below. The gate reports entries here that have gone stale.
